header: What was working when this page was written
lead: A page somebody writes, not a monitor. During an incident the outage map is the faster source, and the recorded announcement on the service line is faster still.
note: Written 12 January 2027, 09:00, and updated by hand. If an entry below contradicts the outage map, the map is right.

metrics.title: District heat, Ashcombe network
metrics.text: Flow temperature held 8 °C lower while the Marrowfield pumping station is rebuilt. Expected back to normal in May 2027.

metrics.title: Charging network, Old Harbour
metrics.text: Fourteen of 340 points offline since the harbour car park works began. No date yet.
